intro.data: Do-nothing steps can sit anywhere — as long as they really do nothing. Your tray holds the Parser, the Charter, the intermediate Clean Table, two do-nothing steps, and a Smudger that only looks like one. Bring the pieces you need onto the board and wire a pipeline that still lands on the clear chart, leaving the Smudger in the tray.
intro.alchemy: Do-nothing steps can sit anywhere — as long as they really do nothing. Your tray holds the Smelter, the Toolsmith, the intermediate Ingot, two do-nothing steps, and a Tainter. Bring the pieces you need onto the board and wire a pipeline that still lands on the fine tool, leaving the Tainter in the tray.
intro.spellcraft: Do-nothing steps can sit anywhere — as long as they really do nothing. Your tray holds Ignition, the Kindler, the intermediate Flame, two do-nothing steps, and a Warper. Bring the pieces you need onto the board and wire a working that still lands on the bright beacon, leaving the Warper in the tray.
intro.abstract: Identity steps can be inserted anywhere they truly leave the value alone. Here the values are plain numbers: id_A sends 3 ↦ 3, f sends 3 ↦ 9, id_B sends 9 ↦ 9, g sends 9 ↦ 30, and the look-alike alters 3 ↦ 8. Bring id_A, f, id_B, g and the intermediate object B onto the board and wire them to still reach the goal value, leaving the look-alike in the tray.

goal.data: Bring the machines, the intermediate Clean Table, and do-nothing steps from the tray and wire a pipeline that still produces the clear chart.
goal.alchemy: Bring the apparatuses, the intermediate Ingot, and do-nothing steps from the tray and wire a pipeline that still produces the fine tool.
goal.spellcraft: Bring the runes, the intermediate Flame, and do-nothing steps from the tray and wire a working that still produces the bright beacon.
goal.abstract: Bring the machines, the intermediate object B, and identity steps from the tray and wire them to reach the goal value, leaving the look-alike in the tray.

description.alchemy: shapes the ingot into a tool
description.spellcraft: kindles the flame into a beacon

afterSuccess.data: Two real do-nothing steps, and the result was identical to the plain Parser→Charter pipeline. Genuine identities can be inserted anywhere; a smudging look-alike cannot.
afterSuccess.alchemy: Two real do-nothing steps, identical to the plain pipeline. Genuine identities insert anywhere; a tainting look-alike cannot.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: Two real do-nothing steps, identical to the plain working. Genuine identities insert anywhere; a warping look-alike cannot.
afterSuccess.abstract: Identities collapse out of the composite: g ∘ id_B ∘ f ∘ id_A = g ∘ f — only the real ones.

reveal.summary: Because each genuine identity leaves every value unchanged, you can insert or remove them freely without changing the composite.
notation: g ∘ id_B ∘ f ∘ id_A = g ∘ f
reveal.moreFormal: Repeated use of the identity law removes every identity from a chain. Only the non-identity steps determine the result.
